title: Akiyama Mizuki — Encouraged By Kindness〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What should I get for N25's New Year's countdown party?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I already bought those limited edition New Year's potato chips... But that alone won't make it feel any different from our usual snacking parties.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I want it to have a little more of a New Year's feel. Also...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Is something wrong, Yuki...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Nothing's wrong, but... I always spent New Year's with my parents and went around to greet my relatives...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (A lot seems to be going through Mafuyu's mind right now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I want this party to be fun and give her a chance to cheer up a bit!)
Huh? Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...? An! Li'l Bro! You're all here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Talk about a coincidence!
Are you guys shopping together?! You're so close!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Not exactly shopping...
We're here to grab some things for our hot pot.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hot pot?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we're having our last practice of the year on New Year's Eve and decided to have a hot pot party afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, that sounds pretty nice.
Choosing what goes in should be fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?
We were just talking about what to put in!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, Mizuki, are you here to shop too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I was just getting some stuff for our New Year's party, but I'm having trouble coming up with good ideas for it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good ideas?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. I got snacks to share, but I wanna do something to make our party feel more like New Year's, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, can I ask what you guys are gonna do for New Year's? That might give me the clue I need!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
For New Year's...?
I mean, we're not doing anything all that special ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm going to do a shrine visit with An, but we're back to practicing like usual right after...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! You guys are having practice over New Year's?! But you just said you're practicing on New Year's Eve!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but you can lose your singing voice after a few days of not practicing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right... Man, you guys are something else.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I knew they were busy based on how they usually are at school...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But it's clear that they're working really hard towards their goal.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Good luck, you guys! I'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of New Year's...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Normally, we'd place some decorative bamboo outside the cafe and hang a shimenawa on the door! Those make it feel like New Year's, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, seeing everyone put those kinds of decorations out really makes it feel like it's that time of year.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Decorations, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that could work!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Especially since the decor shops should be carrying cute New Year's-themed stuff...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I have some friends who might really enjoy seeing fun things like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh... Now that you mention it, we know people who are just like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: One time, we brought them a Hanetsuki set and everyone got quite into it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hanetsuki? Yeah, that sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It was when we played!
We even made things interesting by letting the winners draw stuff on the losers' faces!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Remember how our faces were covered in ink afterwards, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha... Yeah, I remember.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Aww, I would've loved to see that.
There's no way it wasn't funny!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, that would've been way too embarrassing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But maybe we should play again since we have a couple more joining us this year. I think it'll get really heated!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. That sounds like the kind of people you know.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: One or two might make themselves scarce if we start playing those sorts of games...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'll try suggesting it since we'll be spending time together♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks! I really appreciate the help.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm glad we could help!
I hope your party turns out fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright!
I'll start looking for some nice New Year's decorations!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: See you guys...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This might be the last time we see each other before the start of the new year, right? So, I figured I'd say this now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's make next year another good one, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right.
Since we're classmates now, let's make the most of it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I hope we get to keep having fun, Akiyama!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to having another great year with you guys!
